Photo shot list — Sthree Boutique

One row per piece. Take 3 photos of each and name the files with the code shown.

Do not send photos on WhatsApp as pictures — WhatsApp shrinks them and the quality is lost for good. Upload to Google Drive instead, or on WhatsApp use Document (paperclip → Document) so they arrive full size.
Name each file with the code: SB-JWL-01-1.jpg, SB-JWL-01-2.jpg, SB-JWL-01-3.jpg
The 3 shots: 1 = the whole piece, front. 2 = worn, or draped. 3 = close up of the fabric, work or clasp.
Light: stand near a window in daytime. No flash. Same spot and same background every time.
